name: Mobility Disability
description: Difficulty moving due to paralysis, amputation, or other conditions

assistive_tools.name: Wheelchair
assistive_tools.description: Used to help individuals with mobility disabilitiess move around

assistive_tools.name: Crutches
assistive_tools.description: Assist people with mobility difficulties in walking

interaction_guidelines: Do not push a person's wheelchair without permission
Maintain eye level while talking to a wheelchair user
Ensure enough space for movement when sitting with them

name: Visual Disability
description: Partial or complete loss of vision

assistive_tools.name: White Cane
assistive_tools.description: Helps blind individuals navigate their surroundings

assistive_tools.name: Screen Reader Software
assistive_tools.description: Helps visually impaired individuals use computers

assistive_tools.name: Tactile Maps
assistive_tools.description: Help blind individuals locate important places

interaction_guidelines: Ask before assisting a blind person
Do not touch a guide dog or white cane without permission

name: Hearing Disability
description: Partial or complete loss of hearing

assistive_tools.name: Sign Language Interpreter
assistive_tools.description: Helps in communication with deaf individuals

interaction_guidelines: Speak clearly and slowly to a person with hearing disability
Use facial expressions and gestures to help convey meaning

name: Intellectual Disability
description: Difficulties in learning or cognitive development

assistive_tools.name: Alternative Communication Boards
assistive_tools.description: Used to help individuals with speech difficulties communicate

assistive_tools.name: Specialized Learning Applications
assistive_tools.description: Programs designed to aid in skill development

interaction_guidelines: Use simple language and be patient
Give them enough time to respond or make decisions
Avoid speaking to them as if they are children if they are adults

name: Psychological Disability
description: Mental health conditions such as autism, anxiety, or depression

assistive_tools.name: Coping Techniques
assistive_tools.description: Applications for meditation and deep breathing exercises

interaction_guidelines: Do not pressure them to talk if they are not ready
Respect their personal space and emotions

name: Speech and Communication Disability
description: Difficulties in speaking or verbal communication

assistive_tools.name: Speech-Generating Devices
assistive_tools.description: Help individuals with speech difficulties communicate

assistive_tools.name: Instant Translation Apps
assistive_tools.description: Assist in converting text to speech and vice versa

interaction_guidelines: Be patient and do not complete sentences for them
Use alternative methods like writing or gestures if needed
Do not assume they cannot understand you
